paths.@v1/api: The design system takes plain props; the app maps tRPC output (ADR 0004).
paths.@v1/domain: The design system takes values already formatted; the app calls @v1/domain (ADR 0004).
paths.@v1/supabase: The design system takes plain props; the app maps database rows (ADR 0004).
paths.next/navigation: Pass the pathname, an href or a callback; routing stays in the app (ADR 0004).
paths.nuqs: Take value and onChange; the query string stays in the app (ADR 0004).

patterns.message: packages/ui renders plain props and reads its messages through next-intl's hooks; data, routing and the request config stay in apps/app (ADR 0004, 0005).
Derby Sync does not load tokens.css and is a static export, so recipes render unstyled or break there; use @v1/ui primitives (ADR 0004).

paths.@v1/api: Stories render packages/ui from plain values; they have no data layer (ADR 0004).
paths.@v1/domain: Stories pass values already formatted, as the app's mappers would (ADR 0004).
paths.@v1/supabase: Stories render packages/ui from plain values; they have no data layer (ADR 0004).
paths.nuqs: Recipes take value and onChange; a story holds that state with useState (ADR 0004).

patterns.message: apps/storybook renders packages/ui through its exports, like any consumer; import @v1/ui/* (ADR 0004).

paths.react: @v1/game-assets is plain data and URLs, usable by the app, the design system and Derby Sync alike (ADR 0006).
paths.next: @v1/game-assets is plain data and URLs; Next's caching is the caller's, passed in through latestPatch's init (ADR 0006).

patterns.message: @v1/game-assets depends on nothing in the workspace or any framework, so every consumer can use it (ADR 0006).
